title: Acenda reshapes leadership as integration gathers pace
full_text:
Acenda Life has appointed Ross Miller as chief commercial officer, replacing Sean McCormack as the insurer moves into the next phase of its Australian integration and growth strategy.
McCormack will step down after two periods of leadership with the group, having originally joined MLC Life Insurance in 2009 before returning to Acenda Life in 2025 to lead the commercial division through the early integration stages.
In his place, Miller will lead the company’s Australian commercial teams across insurance, wealth and retirement solutions, having joined Acenda in February 2026 as group chief people and culture officer.
Miller previously spent more than 25 years at Westpac Group, holding roles including chief customer and engagement officer for consumer and business banking, general manager of St.George Bank and group general manager of human resources for Westpac’s Australian financial services businesses.
His customer and engagement responsibilities included channel and distribution delivery across operations serving more than 10 million customers.
Lisa Green will succeed Miller in the people and culture role, effective immediately, bringing more than 30 years of human resources experience across Australia and the United States.
The appointments come as Acenda progresses the integration of Acenda Life and Resolution Life Australasia following Nippon Life’s global acquisition of Resolution Life.
Acenda Group chief executive Chris de Bruin said the leadership changes would support the next stage of that process.
“Almost a year into our integration in Australia, the Acenda Group is making strong progress towards a simpler, digitally enabled operating model. These appointments bring together the commercial, customer and people capabilities we need for our next phase, while maintaining disciplined execution for customers, advisers and partners,” de Bruin said.
“Since rejoining the business, Sean has led the Commercial team to important market wins, supported the integration of our teams, helped establish the cultural foundations of our Melbourne office and played a key role in shaping our future strategy. I thank Sean for his contribution and wish him well for the future.”
“Ross has made an exceptional impact since joining Acenda Life earlier this year. He brings more than 20 years of commercial and customer leadership experience across complex financial services businesses.
“His enterprise perspective, deep understanding of customer and distribution operations, and proven ability to lead through transformation will be important as we sharpen our commercial strategy and build a sustainable platform for growth.”
Green has held senior leadership positions at Citigroup and J.P. Morgan in Sydney and New York, and served as group executive, human resources at ASX before joining oOh!media as chief people and culture officer.
She will lead Acenda’s people and culture agenda through its next phase of integration and transformation.
“Lisa brings a wealth of experience across various industries that will be invaluable as we continue to build an integrated, high-performing and people-centred culture across Australia and New Zealand,” de Bruin said.
Formed in October 2025, Acenda Group brings together Acenda Life, Resolution Life Australasia and Asteron Life New Zealand, supporting more than 2 million customers across Australia and New Zealand.
The firm is a sponsor for this year’s Super Fund of the Year Awards, due to be held by Super Review in Melbourne on 12 November.
